name: Gejiu

queries.query: Gejiu official cadastral map parcel viewer land registration GIS Yunnan
queries.result: No public Gejiu parcel viewer or anonymous parcel geometry API was identified in first-party results. The official Gejiu government site identifies the Gejiu Natural Resources Bureau as responsible for cadastral survey, real-estate registration, surveying, and the local natural-resources information platform.

parcelDiscovery.note: No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was exposed by the first-party routes inspected. No GeoJSON sample was retained. This is not evidence of citywide absence.

requestOutcomes.outcome: HTTP/web retrieval successful; official bureau duties page confirms cadastral investigation, real-estate surveying, registration information-platform responsibility, and local registration work.
HTTP/web retrieval successful; official information-disclosure guide identifies real-estate registration information among bureau-held information and provides the local disclosure route.
